name: Sub-Saharan Africa
title: Sub-Saharan Africa add-on: tuberculosis and sickle cell acute chest syndrome
description: TB and the acute chest syndrome of sickle cell disease, both common in the region and both absent from the base corpus.
emergency_note: There is no single emergency number across this region, so the pack names none and says "local emergency services". Base chunks that say 9-1-1 are shown as they are, annotated, never edited or suppressed.
